name: Self Defense
overview: Scripture acknowledges the right to protect oneself and others, as seen when a thief breaking in may be struck without guilt (Exodus 22:2) and when God's people are instructed to arm themselves for battle to uphold justice (Numbers 31:3). The Psalms affirm that God empowers His people to fight and defend the vulnerable from wickedness (Psalms 82:4; 144:1), while Proverbs warns against yielding to evil, portraying such weakness as corrupt and harmful (Proverbs 25:26). Even in practical labor, readiness to defend is commended, as workers held weapons while building the wall (Nehemiah 4:17), illustrating a balance of diligence and vigilance in safeguarding life and community.
